target_customer: Med spas and elective care clinics such as wellness, longevity, dermatology and cosmetic surgery practices
problem: Elective clinics run on several disconnected systems. Decoda offers one EMR and practice platform with scheduling, charting, payments, memberships and AI agents for calls and notes.
product_category: Vertical EMR and practice management for elective care

founders.name: Daniyal Afzal
founders.background_notes: Not listed on the YC page.

founders.name: Kevin Cheng
founders.background_notes: Not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: A full EMR with scheduling, payments, charting and HIPAA compliance is broad but standard software; e-prescribing integration adds regulatory work.

defensibility.rationale: Practice systems hold patient records and payments, creating high switching costs, though established med spa vendors compete.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Incumbents remain in the market per 2026 comparison guides. No acquisition of Decoda found.

market_need_then: Med spas were a growing elective segment using fragmented tools. Specific 2023 evidence was not found.

branding.domain_note: Uses decodahealth.com, with the h inserted between name and Health.

identity.visual_style: Product mockups and patient-journey walkthroughs, rocket emoji in an announcement banner

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found. The name is easily confused with Decode Health and Decoded Health, other health companies.

outcome_analysis: Decoda is active and says it serves over 150 live clinics with over 100 million dollars in annual transactions, both company claims. Its site announces a 4.5 million dollar raise led by Y Combinator. It competes with established med spa software vendors, and the exact timeline of its funding is unclear.
notes: The round is confirmed only by the company's own site banner with no date. Aggregators conflict: Caplight dates a 4.5M seed July 2023, VCBacked and Simplify say November 2025, Seedtable shows September 2023, and others list a 500K pre-seed from YC in 2023. Round date left null; amount counted as stated by the company. Other sources name James Oswald as CTO and co-founder, but I did not open a source confirming that, so he is omitted. Competition list empty: only 2025 to 2026 guides found. Founders' prior employers and education not found.
